trial_court: Court of learned District Judge Kishtwar, TrP (C) No26/2021
case_name: Shallu Alias Anjali vs Vikas Sharma
facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized in accordance with Hindu rights and customs. The petitioner was forced to leave the matrimonial home after one and a half month after the birth of child due to harassment and torture by the respondent. The petitioner seeks transfer of the case from Kishtwar to any other competent Court at Jammu.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking transfer of a case has to demonstrate sufficient grounds for the same.
legal_principles.held: The burden lies on the petitioner to demonstrate sufficient grounds for transfer of the case.

legal_principles.principle: A party's convenience or hardship is not a sufficient ground for transfer of a case.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner has never been to Kishtwar in the house of respondent, as alleged in the petition. The parties have never been together or lived together at Kishtwar.

outcome.final_order: The present application has been allowed and the case is transferred to any other court of competent jurisdiction at Jammu.
